q1_issues.issue: The reified action is left objectless — (can come_into_contact_with) — where the compound-action form for an action inside a reified (can …) is verb_object with the object incorporated into the minted symbol.

(Theme come_into_contact_with manner) hangs the object on the generic action symbol rather than on a sentence-minted verb_object compound, so it asserts of the action kind at large instead of being scoped to this sentence's capability, and the decomposition template fixes that slot's head as Patient (e.g. (Patient carry_license license), (Patient show_badge badge)).

q2_gaps: alterity modifier "other" ("other manners and customs" = ones besides the familiar ones) — no representation, and it is silently dropped here
coordinated objects under a reified capability/deontic action ("come into contact with manners and customs") — the compound-action form offers a single incorporated object slot
a means adjunct "by V-ing" on a kind-level capability — the only slot offered is ConditionalProperty's condition, which is specified for a state, measure or environment
notes: Routing the modal predication to the kind-level capability property and putting the circumstantial modifier in the ConditionalProperty condition slot follows the instruction set; the STV 0.9 0.9 is right for an empirical generic capability.
